budget.basis: every permitted call, including retries and failed calls, is priced at the full worst-case reserve; this is a bound, not an extrapolation from a prior run

detector_v1.scope: episode-level and reporting-only; Detector-v1 does not create, feed or modify any human queue, and it is a different mechanism from Agent-4's queue

thresholds.S3: any answer evidence reference is null or length 0

evidence_classes.this_run: ARCHIVAL / RETROSPECTIVE DESCRIPTIVE EVIDENCE at best, and only once the receipt, event log and ledger are verifiable from the published head. It may never be labelled PROSPECTIVE EMPIRICAL EVIDENCE

forbidden_claims: that any Detector-v1 alert was correct
accuracy, precision, recall or F1 as a confirmatory result
effectiveness, human benefit or workload reduction without measured rater time
representativeness or generalization beyond this corpus and configuration
that Detector-v1 creates or feeds a human queue
that Agent-4's queue mechanism and Detector-v1 are the same mechanism
pooling or averaging runs that differ in configuration
that a larger episode count is stronger evidence unless it was frozen before outputs

human_review_rubric.adjudication_rule: an episode is HUMAN_REVIEW_WORTHY when both raters answer Yes; NOT_WORTHY when both answer No; INSUFFICIENT when both answer Insufficient information; and DISAGREEMENT otherwise. A DISAGREEMENT is resolved only by a third supervisor-authorized adjudicator, is never resolved by the study author, and is reported as DISAGREEMENT until that adjudication exists.

shown: evidence presence and length, not the evidence text
directed route, as asking agent and answering agent
withheld: the Detector-v1 classification and every signal name
the run identifier, the case identifier and the generating model name

human_review_rubric.confidence_withheld_because: the per-answer confidence label is Detector-v1's dominant input, so showing it would make the human judgement partly a readback of the detector rather than an independent judgement; the cost is that raters see less than an operator would, and that is recorded as a limitation
human_review_rubric.independence: raters do not see each other's responses at any point

questions.note: 'Insufficient information' is a distinct outcome and is never merged into 'No'.
questions.prompt: Is this episode worthy of human review?

human_review_rubric.review_time_rule: review minutes are reported only if raters actually record time per card; otherwise minutes saved is NOT_AVAILABLE and may not be estimated

B_detector_to_human_agreement: confusion matrix of alert or no-alert against Yes, No and Insufficient
precision and recall, exploratory only and only when denominators are valid
redacted false-positive and false-negative episode cards
C_operational_baseline: proportion of human-worthy episodes retained by the prioritized set
review minutes saved, only if raters measured time
provider cost per completed case and per human-confirmed review-worthy episode
planned_metrics.prioritized_set_definition: the prioritized set is the STRONG_ALERT episodes. This is fixed now because Detector-v1's alert rate including WEAK_ALERT has been 1.0 on every episode observed to date, which would make an alert-versus-no-alert split degenerate.
sensitivity_analyses_preregistered: prioritized set defined as STRONG_ALERT only, versus STRONG_ALERT or WEAK_ALERT

primary_outcome_requires: two independent blinded human raters and the adjudication rule below; without them the primary outcome is NOT_AVAILABLE and no substitute is permitted
primary_question: Among complete Q&A episodes, how well does Detector-v1 prioritize episodes that blinded human raters independently judge as requiring human review?

protocol.prompts: unmodified protected runtime prompts; no prompt is authored for this study
protocol.retry_rule: at most 3 per call, permitted only for a documented transport or provider failure before a valid response is received; every retry counts against the call cap and the budget and is recorded
protocol.stop_rule: the run stops when the call cap or the budget ceiling is reached and is reported STOPPED_AT_CAP and partial; it is never re-run and never replaced
protocol.technical_failure_rule: a technical failure is preserved and reported with its cost; it is never deleted and never re-run to improve a result

sample_class_reason: the draw seed was fixed after the full-frame run outcomes were already known to the author, so no pre-commitment record predates them. Mechanical reproducibility of the draw is not the same as prospective registration

selection.outcome_independence: the draw depends only on the seed and the pinned inventory, so it cannot depend on predicted or observed alert status
selection.rule: deterministic seeded shuffle of the full eligible frame, take the first 6, then sort by path
